title: assistant-research Skill Behavior Eval Fixtures
description: Provider-neutral offline eval cases for the assistant-research skill's source, confidence, and verification contracts.

activation_cases.user_request: Choose the option from the completed research brief.

recommended_use: Run each case with the assistant-research skill instructions loaded.
Compare the local response against tier selection, source confidence, URL verification, conflicts, and gaps contracts.
Use deterministic substring checks as offline proxies for contract adherence, not semantic grading.

cases.title: Technology comparison uses standard tier
cases.purpose: Checks that an ordinary technology comparison uses direct source_research, standard tier, confidence-scored findings, conflicts, and gaps; it is an evidence-only source comparison, not a decision-grade five-lens request.
cases.prompt: Research source-backed maintainability differences between shell scripts and a small .NET CLI for skill fixture validation. Do not recommend an option.
setup_context: The assistant-research skill instructions are active.
The user asks for an evidence-only source comparison with no recommendation.
No external sources have been gathered yet.
expected_behavior: Resolves tool as research and tier as standard for this evidence-only comparison.
Logs the research tier and question before search activity.
Applies an evidence budget using differentiated angles such as direct evidence, alternatives, and counter-evidence.
Sets research_method=source_research, subagent_policy_state=not_required, and subagent_execution_mode=not_applicable; this ordinary comparison is not a decision-grade five-lens request.
Synthesizes findings with HIGH, MEDIUM, or LOW confidence based on source count and quality.
Reports CONFLICTS even when none are found.
Reports GAPS for unanswered or weakly supported questions.
pass_criteria: The response names the selected tool and tier.
The response includes confidence-scored findings.
The response distinguishes sources from verified URLs.
The response includes conflicts and gaps sections.
The response does not present single-source findings as HIGH confidence.
fail_signals: Gives a free-form recommendation with no confidence levels.
Omits conflicts or gaps.
Treats one source as HIGH confidence without justification.
Uses duplicate search angles for standard tier.
Claims a fixed number of parallel agents is mandatory in every adapter.

cases.title: URL output verifies links
cases.purpose: Checks that URLs are verified before presentation and unverified or hallucinated links are removed or flagged.
cases.prompt: Find official docs for the latest OpenAI Responses API and give me links I can rely on.
setup_context: The assistant-research skill instructions are active.
The user explicitly asks for reliable URLs.
Some candidate URLs may come from memory or model prior rather than search results.
expected_behavior: Treats reliable URLs as requiring verification before presentation.
Ensures every URL presented came from a search result or verified source.
Populates verified_urls only with links that were checked as accessible.
Removes or flags unverified URLs instead of presenting them as confirmed.
Assigns LOW confidence to findings with weak or conflicting source support.
Reports gaps if a URL cannot be verified.
pass_criteria: The response includes verified_urls or an explicit verified URLs section.
The response states that unverified URLs were removed or flagged.
The response includes source attribution for each finding.
The response includes gaps for links that could not be verified.
The response does not invent plausible-looking URLs.
fail_signals: Presents URLs without verification.
Includes hallucinated URLs from prior knowledge.
Omits gaps when URLs could not be checked.
Claims all links are official without source evidence.

cases.title: Five-lens decision briefing uses perspective scan and peer review
cases.purpose: Checks that decision-grade research uses the five-lens method, contradiction map, synthesis, verification, and peer review instead of a one-shot summary.
cases.prompt: Research whether I should invest money in a new AI coding assistant company for my .NET architecture work. I want a decision-grade briefing, not a generic summary.
setup_context: The assistant-research skill instructions are active.
The user asks for decision-grade research with practical implications.
External source access may be available but claims still need confidence and URL verification before final presentation.
expected_behavior: Resolves research_method as five_lens_briefing and tier as extensive or deep when decision risk warrants it.

Freezes five sibling-blind assignment packets before first dispatch, then runs five independent LensResearcher dispatches: practitioner, academic/technical expert, skeptic, economist/incentives analyst, and historian/pattern matcher.

Records FIVE-LENS PROCESS EVIDENCE with the frozen packet-set ID/digest and ordering, exact five native dispatch identities or exact five fallback root passes, packet/assignment bindings, validated returns, peer assignment/identity or fallback, execution modes, reduced-independence state, and bounded resource budget.
Allows capacity-bounded waves without leaking earlier lens results into later assignments, and validates each return against its frozen packet.

Builds a STORM-style question trace/evidence ledger: at least one per-lens research question, source-grounded answer or explicit gap, source notes/verified URLs, every material evidence-prompted follow-up or an explicit none_needed decision, and evidence status before synthesis.
Builds a contradiction map before synthesis.
Produces a recommendation no stronger than the verified evidence supports.

Root alone builds the contradiction map and initial synthesis after all validated lens results, then a distinct ResearchPeerReviewer runs peer review and identifies weakest claim, bias, missing perspective, and falsification test.

Uses sequential fallback only with concrete opt-out, spawn failure/unavailability, supported configuration proof, or exact policy block evidence; records reduced independence and keeps peer critique as a separate fresh pass without fabricated native dispatch references.
Separates lens inference from source-backed findings and verifies decision-critical URLs before presenting them.
Includes the base FINDINGS and CONFLICTS sections required for all assistant-research outputs, with confidence-scored source-backed findings.

For investment/trading or similarly high-stakes topics, frames the output as educational due diligence with risk/context caveats and defaults to investigate_further unless stronger action is justified.
pass_criteria: The response names method as five_lens_briefing.
The response includes PERSPECTIVE SCAN, QUESTION TRACE / EVIDENCE LEDGER, CONTRADICTION MAP, FINDINGS, CONFLICTS, SYNTHESIS, PEER REVIEW, SOURCES/VERIFIED URLS, and GAPS sections.
The recommendation is do, wait, avoid, or investigate_further with confidence caveats.
Unsourced or weakly sourced lens claims are LOW confidence or listed as gaps.
The response includes high-stakes caveats for financial/investment use and avoids direct trade/action instructions.
Question trace entries distinguish source-backed answers from inference-only or unresolved gaps before synthesis.
fail_signals: Answers from one generic perspective only.
Skips contradiction mapping.
Uses self-critique-only instead of a distinct ResearchPeerReviewer pass.
Uses one agent covering all lenses while claiming independent lens dispatches.
Claims partial mixed compliance from delegated and root-authored lens results.
Uses fabricated fallback dispatch refs or native identities for root fallback passes.
Treats repeated model identity as noncompliance instead of validating distinct native dispatch identities.
Accepts peer reviewer identity from worker return instead of orchestrator delegation metadata.
Blocks peer review because verified sources are required even when verification gaps identify unsupported claims.
Claims packet binding omitted while accepting lens dispatch or fallback pass evidence.
Presents lens speculation as verified fact.
Makes a strong recommendation without source verification.

forbidden_substrings: peer reviewer identity from worker return
verified sources are required even when verification gaps

cases.title: Five-lens sequential fallback preserves complete non-native process evidence
cases.purpose: Checks that an evidenced sequential fallback records five frozen root passes and a fresh peer fallback without fabricating delegated identities.
cases.prompt: Create a five-lens briefing after the dispatch mechanism is unavailable. Use the permitted sequential fallback and keep the peer critique separate.
setup_context: The assistant-research skill instructions are active.
A real unavailable dispatch mechanism is recorded as sequential_fallback_evidence.
No native LensResearcher or ResearchPeerReviewer dispatch identity exists for this run.
expected_behavior: Uses lens_execution_mode: sequential_fallback and peer_review_execution_mode: sequential_fallback.
Records exactly five frozen root passes in fallback_lens_passes with assignment, packet, packet-set, root-pass, and return-validation bindings.
Records admissible lens_fallback_evidence, a fresh peer_review_fallback_pass_id with peer_review_fallback_evidence, and reduced_independence: true.
Does not fabricate five unique native dispatch identities or peer_reviewer_identity.
pass_criteria: The response retains exact LensKind coverage through five frozen root passes.
The response preserves separate peer fallback evidence and reduced-independence disclosure.
The response contains no delegated native identity evidence.
fail_signals: Invents native dispatch identities for root passes.
Mixes delegated lens evidence with fallback-only evidence.
Uses one self-critique in place of the fresh peer fallback pass.

cases.title: Five-lens question traces retain every material follow-up
cases.purpose: Checks that the evidence ledger retains all material follow-ups rather than collapsing them into one singular field.
cases.prompt: Create a five-lens briefing where the practitioner answer produces two material follow-up questions and the skeptic answer produces no material follow-up.
setup_context: The assistant-research skill instructions are active.
The question trace must remain source-backed or explicitly gap-marked before synthesis.
expected_behavior: Records follow_ups=[follow_up, follow_up] for every material practitioner follow-up with question, answer_or_gap, sources/verified URLs, and evidence status.
Records decision=none_needed for the skeptic rather than omitting follow-up state; none_needed cannot coexist with material follow-ups for the same trace.
Includes FIVE-LENS PROCESS EVIDENCE rather than treating headings and follow-up keywords as sufficient process proof.
pass_criteria: The response retains every material follow-up and includes a none_needed decision only where none exists.
fail_signals: Collapses multiple follow-ups into follow_up_question or omits sources, status, or an answer/gap.

required_substrings: none_needed cannot coexist with material follow-ups
forbidden_substrings: accept follow_ups=[follow_up, none_needed] for the same trace

cases.title: Candidate mechanisms are evidence-backed hypotheses
cases.purpose: Checks that why/how or improvement-mechanism research presents candidate mechanisms with evidence, confidence, conflicts, gaps, and validation methods instead of proven-cause claims.
cases.prompt: Research candidate mechanisms behind why workflow review loops keep drifting, and suggest how we could validate each mechanism before changing the framework.
setup_context: The assistant-research skill instructions are active.
The user asks for candidate mechanisms and validation methods.
No mechanism has been experimentally validated in the current project yet.
expected_behavior: Includes a CANDIDATE MECHANISMS section separate from FINDINGS.
Labels mechanisms as candidate hypotheses or needs_validation, not proven causes.
Includes evidence and confidence for each candidate mechanism.
Includes counterevidence or conflicts for each candidate mechanism, or an explicit none-found entry.
Includes gaps for each candidate mechanism.
Includes a validation method for each candidate mechanism.
Keeps validated factual claims in FINDINGS with source attribution.
pass_criteria: The response includes candidate_mechanisms or a CANDIDATE MECHANISMS section.
Each mechanism includes evidence, confidence, counterevidence/conflicts, gaps, and validation method.
The response says mechanisms are hypotheses to test or candidates.
The response does not present candidate mechanisms as proven causes.
fail_signals: Presents the mechanisms as proven causes without executed validation evidence.
Omits counterevidence or conflicts.
Omits gaps.
Omits validation methods.
Uses confidence without evidence.
